channelMetadataRenderer.title: Mosfilm
channelMetadataRenderer.description:
Russian Cinema Masterpieces for all Mankind. 

The official channel of the Mosfilm Cinema Concern. 

Mosfilm's golden collection presents over 1000 Soviet and Russian films. You can watch the best comedies, melodramas, detectives, action films, dramas, adventures online in high quality on our YouTube channel. 

Many films have undergone digital restoration and are available in FullHD and 4K formats. Eternal classics, old hits, new items of Russian cinema, excerpts and songs from Soviet films - you can find all this here.

Every week we come up with new ideas for what to watch for the weekend. Subscribe to the channel and click on the bell not to miss new videos. Join our regular Friday broadcasts as well. Let's watch the best Soviet and Russian films together!
